_help: Edit and save: audio-server reloads this file on the next TTS request (./audio is bind-mounted into the container). 'replacements' run first, in order; literal matches are whole-word and case-sensitive unless ignore_case is true; set regex: true for a regular expression (use \1 for groups). 'pronunciations' map a word to IPA in misaki's phoneme set, emitted as [word](/ipa/). Preview with POST :8082/api/tts/normalize {"text": "..."}.
